name: Raspberry Pi M.2 HAT+ (M Key) for Raspberry Pi 5
shortDescription: Official Raspberry Pi add-on board for NVMe SSDs and M.2 devices on Pi 5.
description: The official Raspberry Pi M.2 HAT+ connects an M.2 M-key NVMe SSD or AI accelerator to the Raspberry Pi 5 PCIe interface. Boot faster and add fast storage to your Pi projects.
highlights: For NVMe SSDs and AI accelerators
